case_table.permutation: for position p=0..1023, lattice_index=(405*p+97) mod 1024; top_index=lattice_index mod 32; bottom_index=floor(lattice_index/32)
case_table.canonical_rows: JSON list, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'); each row has bottom_h, case_id=position, role, top_h

physics.volumetric_source: dimensionless q=1 on 0.25<=z<=0.30 and zero elsewhere; canonical Heat3D dimensionalization q=25 K-equivalent source
physics.top_and_bottom: Robin with case top_h and bottom_h
physics.ambient: u=0.2, equivalent T_ref=298.15 K under T=293.15+25u

reference_solver.required: same physical PDE, fixed geometry/k/q, case-specific top/bottom Robin BC and side adiabatic BC
reference_solver.fidelity_gate: must be validated against any released upstream field before formal label production; otherwise fail closed

metrics.runtime: remeasure both methods on identical hardware before direct comparison

model_use.DeepOHeat: retain upstream physics training and per-epoch continuous random HTC sampling; evaluate on the frozen test cases
model_use.Heat3D: supervised train/valid roles above, deterministic converter only, no added physics information
